mapper.select: SELECT * FROM escrows WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE escrows SET held_amount = held_amount - #{releaseAmount}, released_amount = released_amount + #{releaseAmount}, escrow_status = CASE WHEN (held_amount - #{releaseAmount}) = 0 THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_RELEASED' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE escrow_id = #{escrowId} AND held_amount >= #{releaseAmount}

UPDATE escrows SET held_amount = held_amount - #{refundAmount}, refunded_amount = refunded_amount + #{refundAmount}, escrow_status = CASE WHEN (held_amount - #{refundAmount}) = 0 AND released_amount = 0 THEN 'REFUNDED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE escrow_id = #{escrowId} AND held_amount >= #{refundAmount}
UPDATE escrows SET escrow_status = #{escrowStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE escrow_id = #{escrowId}

UPDATE escrows SET held_amount = #{heldAmount}, released_amount = #{releasedAmount}, refunded_amount = #{refundedAmount}, escrow_status = #{escrowStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE escrow_id = #{escrowId}
